19 | Rapid Tendon Regeneration | 1 target | P | touch | U

50 | Soft Structure Repair True | 1 target | P | touch | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows caster to repair (not replace) one sprain. Requires a one hour
operation.
@@ 2
Caster acquires complete understanding of any muscle and/or tendon damage,
including the tools and methods required for healing. Caster does not receive
the skill or power necessary to perform the cure.
@@ 3
Allows caster to repair 1 damaged muscle. Requires a 1 minute operation.
Recovery time is 1 day per muscle repaired.
@@ 4
Allows caster to repair 1 damaged tendon. Requires a 1 minute operation.
Recovery time is 1 day per tendon repaired.
@@ 5
Allows caster to prevent the deteriorization of 1 limb (even while severed).
Requires the use of Limb Preservation from the Bone Mastery spell list as
well.
@@ 6
As Muscle Repair I, except that caster can repair 3 damaged muscles.
@@ 7
As Tendon Repair I, except that caster can repair 3 damaged tendons.
@@ 8
As Muscle Repair, except recovery time is instantaneous.
@@ 9
Allows caster to reattach 1 severed limb. Also requires the use of the other 3
Lay Healer Joining spells to make limb fully functional. Limb is fully
functional after 10-100 days.
@@ 10
As Tendon Repair, except recovery time is instantaneous.
@@ 11
Allows caster to repair all tendon and muscle damage in target’s body. This
requires a 1 hour operation. Recovery time is 1-10 days.
@@ 12
Allows caster to transplant a healthy muscle into the target. This requires a
1 hour operation. Recovery time is 1-10 days. There is a chance that the
target’s body will reject the new bone: 10% if bone is from the same race as
the target, 50% is the bone is from some other similiar race.
@@ 14
Allows caster to regenerate 1 muscle. Regrowth takes 1-10 days, depending on
extent of loss.
@@ 15
Allows caster to regenerate 1 tendon. Regrowth takes 1-10 days, depending on
extent of loss.
@@ 17
As Muscle Transplant, except recovery time is 1-10 hours.
@@ 18
As Muscle Regeneration, except recovery time is 1-10 hours.
@@ 19
As Tendon Regeneration, except recovery time is 1-10 hours.
@@ 20
As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Lay Healer Joining True spells
and the limb is fully functional in 10 minutes.
@@ 25
As Muscle Regeneration, except that regrowth takes 10 minutes.
@@ 30
As Tendon Regeneration, except that regrowth takes 10 minutes.
@@ 50
As Soft Structure Repair, except that all tendons and muscles in target’s body
are repaired (not replaced). This requires a 10 minute operation. Recovery
time is 1-10 days.
